code_behavior_review: Frozen model is SHA-gated, eval, and requires_grad false.
Predict adds reflect101 100px once and subtracts it from every returned point and box.
Nine native camera-facing query points are deployment predictions, not ground-truth semantic native8.
Every returned candidate preserved; argmax first tie and no-detection null are input-only.
No call to branch refinement, restore_refinement, PnP, optimizer or visibility model is authorized by this protocol.
limitation: File hash/IHDR metadata audit only; no new RGB visual review or empirical model-output validation. Root will bind/run the actual runner, then saved-output audit can check this contract.
